name: Agent Governance
author: TheDub-lab
description: Live AI agent governance bar widget for safety-protocol (agentcover-sovereign): monitor spend and blocked actions, approve or deny gated tool calls, inspect the hash-chained audit trail, and trigger the kill switch.

barWidget.description: Live status, spend, pending approvals, hash-chained audit trail, and kill switch for safety-guard.

schema.label: Guard service URL
schema.description: Loopback URL for `safety-guard serve` (GET /health, GET /audit, POST /approve, POST /killswitch).

schema.label: MCP control URL
schema.description: Loopback URL for `safety-guard mcp-proxy` approval control endpoint (GET /pending, POST /approve).

schema.label: Approver identity
schema.description: Operator name recorded in the hash-chained audit trail when approving or denying actions.

schema.label: Approver secret file
schema.description: Optional path to the 0600 secret file written by `safety-guard mcp-proxy --approver-secret-file`.

schema.label: Notify on pending approval
schema.description: Send an Omarchy desktop notification when a new gated action waits for approval.
